episodes.title: "You're Exaggerating" #Exjw
episodes.description: Am I making JWs look worse than they are? The YouTuber who studied for 6 months, who I referenced in the video, went back and forth with me and then threatened to block me. This reminded me of the way that the Org of Jehovah's Witnesses tries to silence those of us who chose to speak out against their injustices. This YouTuber also kept telling those of us who had been through a disfellowshipping that the Org had every right to kick us out, since it's like a club, and private clubs have the right to gatekeep who can be in their club. Um, we were BORN in that system!!!!! When exactly did we have the option to choose to be in the club or not. We were brainwashed from birth, indoctrinated, coerced into baptisms, often very young and before we could really grasp the gravity of what we were doing.  #Exjw
